local_coordinate_frame.note: Targets are emitted as camera-space 3D coordinates. The simplified hull formula frame uses length/width/height parameters that the generator maps onto the configured Defender local axes.

origin_definition: Generator-derived simplified virtual hull over the placed/scaled Defender mesh; origin for hull formulas is rear-bottom centre, not a literal mesh vertex.

local_parameter_frame.formula_axes: (length_x, width_y, height_z) as supplied in the design definition
local_parameter_frame.length_x: rear-to-front distance, rear face at 0 and front face at L
local_parameter_frame.width_y: vehicle width, left side at -W/2 and right side at +W/2
local_parameter_frame.height_z: vehicle height, bottom at 0 and roof at H_roof
local_parameter_frame.generator_axis_mapping: length_x -> configured Defender forward axis, width_y -> configured Defender right axis, height_z -> configured Defender up axis

local_parameter_definitions.H_body: bonnet/body height at the simplified front body datum
local_parameter_definitions.X_screen: x-position in the formula frame of the top/front edge of the windscreen or front roof edge

measurement_notes: The schema uses a simplified 10-point virtual hull; points are not required to coincide with literal rounded FBX mesh vertices.
The four rear datums are rear_bottom_left, rear_bottom_right, rear_roof_left, and rear_roof_right.
The four front lower/body datums are front_bottom_left, front_bottom_right, front_body_left, and front_body_right.
The two top windscreen/front-roof-edge datums are screen_top_left and screen_top_right.
The lower windscreen-base corners are deliberately omitted.
Amodal 3D targets are supervised regardless of per-keypoint visibility.
visibility_test_method: A keypoint is visible when the simplified virtual hull datum is directly visible to the camera under the dataset generator visibility test; visibility is an auxiliary target and must not mask amodal 3D supervision.
